title: An action body the runtime cannot compile (`const input = …` in a script action) passes validate, build and verify, then answers every run_action with an opaque 500 INTERNAL_ERROR
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

## What happens
In the scenario half of qa#1 routine round 2 (requisition_to_receipt, subject `f6f5b50a`, workspace packages), the authored build passed `objectstack validate`, `build` and `verify`. Its script actions then answered all 14 `run_action` calls with `500 INTERNAL_ERROR "Internal server error"`:
- `decide_approval_step` ×8
- `raise_purchase_order` ×5
- `record_goods_receipt` ×1

The MCP caller gets no hint of the cause. The agent fell back to raw writes and left the state wrong.

## Reproduction
1. Give an action `body.source: "const input = ctx.input || {}; return 1;"`.
2. `objectstack build` passes.
3. `run_action` answers 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR`. The server log says `SyntaxError: invalid redefinition of parameter name`.

## Mechanism (runner's probe in the kept project)
The runtime wraps an action body as `(async (input, ctx) => { SOURCE })`. QuickJS rejects a body that redeclares `input` with `const`.

## Expected
- An action body that cannot compile in the runtime's wrapper is refused at validate, build or publish, naming the action and the compile error.
- At run time, the answer names the action and the cause (a 4xx/5xx with a code), never a bare "Internal server error".
- The redeclaration is an easy mistake for an AI author, because `input` reads like a free variable.

Found by: `qa#1` routine round 2, scenario half (round record on #31433), requisition_to_receipt, checks `manager_approves_level_one`, `manager_approves_finance_level`, `receive_more_than_ordered` (agent half) and `raise_po_from_text`.
